2607.08117.title: COALA: Robust Contextualized Speech-augmented Language Modeling for ASR via Contrastive Regularizer and Biasing Score Estimation
2607.08117.paper_summary: Contextual biasing seeks to integrate external knowledge into automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems to accurately recognize domain-specific entities. In this paper, we propose COALA (Contextualized ASR Leveraging Biasing Scoring), a robust framework designed to enhance speech-augmented language models (SLMs) in complex multi-entity scenarios. Considering the inherent context-window limitations of SLMs, identifying relevant target entities from a large-scale biasing list is crucial for effective recognition. To this end, COALA maps SLM latent representations into a specialized discriminative space to quantify the matching intensity between audio segments and candidate entities. Furthermore, we address the training collapse in prior study when handling multi-target utterances-where multiple rare words co-occur. Experimental results on the LibriSpeech benchmark demonstrate that COALA consistently achieves superior contextual biasing performance across various biasing list scales.
2607.08117.paper_summary_zh: 上下文偏見旨在將外部知識整合到自動語音識別（ASR）系統中，以準確識別特定領域的實體。<lb/>在本文中，我們提出了COALA（上下文化的ASR利用偏見評分），這是一個旨在增強語音增強語言模型（SLMs）在複雜多實體場景中的穩健框架。<lb/>考慮到SLMs固有的上下文窗口限制，從大規模偏見列表中識別相關目標實體對於有效識別至關重要。<lb/>為此，COALA將SLM潛在表示映射到一個專門的區分空間，以量化音頻片段與候選實體之間的匹配強度。<lb/>此外，我們解決了先前研究中處理多目標發話時的訓練崩潰問題——即多個稀有詞同時出現的情況。<lb/>在LibriSpeech基準測試上的實驗結果顯示，COALA在各種偏見列表規模中始終實現了卓越的上下文偏見性能。
